title: Codkii Duufaanta Ka Hor
intro: Qof cidlada ku nool ayaa kacay si uu ugu yeero qaran awood leh runta. Dadku waxay caan ku ahaayeen dhismahooda quruxda badan iyo xooggooda aan la barbar dhigi karin. Haddana kibirkoodu wuu indho tiray, wayna diideen inay dhegeystaan. Ugu dambeyntii, ciqaab ba'an ayaa ku dhacday, iyadoo badbaadisay koox yar oo mu'miniin ah.
clues: Waxaa la ii diray dad awood leh oo ku noolaa dhulalka bannaanka ah, waxaana la ii yaqaanay awooddooda.
Dadkaygu waxay ka dambeeyeen qaran kale oo weyn oo la burburiyay.
Waxay lahaayeen dhismayaal aad u qurux badan waxayna dhiseen munaarado dhaadheer.
Waxaan ugu yeeray inay caabudaan hal Ilaah, laakiin way diideen inay ka tagaan sanamyadooda.
Ciqaab daran ayaa ku dhacday, iyadoo ka badbaadisay oo keliya kuwa i rumaystay.
Aniga ayaa ah qofkii loo diray dad xoog badan oo loo yaqaan Caad.

arabic: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَآءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ لِيُنذِرَكُمْ ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَزَادَكُمْ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ بَصْۜطَةًۭ ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verse: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allāh that you might succeed." (7:69)
